handoff.notes:
## Goal

The hourly retention pass deletes cancelled queue tickets, which are dead copies of a player's deck. A new store method `tickets_purge(cutoff)` exists on both stores. It deletes every ticket with `status = 'cancelled'` and `enqueued_at` strictly before the cutoff, and answers the count. It never touches a queued or a claimed ticket. A new retention step calls it with `now − QUEUE_TICKET_CANCELLED_KEEP_SECONDS`. The step has its own `FailingStreak` (`tickets.purge`) and logs `tickets.purged` and `tickets.purge_failed`. R4446000 records the decision, SPEC §9.5 and the server README say so, and no migration or index is added. Claimed tickets stay, because `matches_mode_of` reads a queue match's mode from its ticket.

## Files to touch

| File | | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/server/src/config.rs` | change | New `QUEUE_TICKET_CANCELLED_KEEP_SECONDS: i64 = 3600`, after `QUEUE_ENDED_AFTER_READS` (~line 628). |
| `crates/server/src/db/store.rs` | change | `Tx::tickets_purge(&mut self, cutoff: i64) -> StoreResult<i64>`, after `tickets_cancel` (~line 1993). |
| `crates/server/src/db/pg.rs` | change | `pub async fn tickets_purge`, after `tickets_cancel` (~line 3981). |
| `crates/server/src/db/fake.rs` | change | `pub fn tickets_purge`, after `tickets_cancel` (~line 1861). |
| `crates/server/src/api/retention.rs` | change | Header bullet, import, `purge_tickets`, `ticketing` streak and step in `run_purge`. |
| `crates/server/src/alerts.rs` | change | `"tickets.purge.failing"` arm in `meaning`; `FAILING_STEPS` 18→19 with `"tickets.purge"`. |
| `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs` | change | New case in `mod tickets`. |
| `crates/server/tests/api/retention.rs` | change | Two new tests, one import line and one helper. |
| `crates/server/tests/loops/failing.rs` | change | One new test, after `r4390001_…`. |
| `crates/server/README.md` | change | Steps list (~811–813) and retention paragraph (~1158–1159). |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | One sentence in §9.5's first bullet (line 63). |
| `spec/rulings/R4446000.md` | new | The ruling note. |
| `spec/pending/4446.md` | new | The §11 paragraph. |

Governing: SPEC §9.5, R897000 (stale sweep), R4390000 and R4390001 (the precedent; commit `0b6703d0cd` has the same shape), R640002 and `matches_mode_of` (why claimed tickets stay). CLAUDE.md rules 3 and 9.

**Do not touch:** `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/server/migrations/`, `apps/web` (including `serverConfig.ts` and the privacy page), the engine, cards and AI crates, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index` or `fold`.

## Steps

1. **`config.rs`.** After `QUEUE_ENDED_AFTER_READS` add:
   ```rust
   /// R4446000: seconds a cancelled queue ticket is kept, counted from its enqueue, before the hourly
   /// retention purge may delete it. An hour: the enqueue's read-back and the pairing's re-read both
   /// happen inside one request, long before.

## 6. Risks

- **Animation timing divergence between FxLayer and Result**: `FxLayer` plays the lethal lead and Victory/Defeat cues only on the condition `previousResult === null && view.result !== null`. If `GameResult` used a different condition or waited on initial mount, the panel would either appear over a running animation or stay invisible with nothing playing. By coupling `arrived` strictly to whether the board mounted on an in-progress game (`shown.result === null`), `GameResult` waits if and only if `FxLayer` triggers its cues.
- **Layout shift**: Hiding the End turn button upon game over was rejected because it would shift the rail layout right when the result arrives. Keeping the button visible in its `"over"` state with the same physical dimensions and sunken styling prevents layout jumping.
- **Rule 7 (Presentation purity)**: Neither End turn wording nor result reveal timing affects game state or sends illegal intents; legality remains governed by engine views.

# Plan (opus, strong)

## Goal

Give Evasive its own entry in the AI's keyword table, so `unit_worth` counts an Evasive unit's protection (SPEC §6, R3543002, R4353002). Through `unit_worth` it reaches `kill_worth`, the reply's `trade_value` and the move order's even trades (#1779). The change: `KeywordWeights.evasive` (serde `Evasive`) and its `of()` arm, at the issue's start of 1.0 in `AI_EVAL` and 0.0 in the frozen `GREEDY_EVAL`. Scene tests in a new `crates/ai/tests/ai/evasive.rs` prove it. It gets one fork screen (`training/improve.md`, A screen), with the tally recorded in the knob's comment.

This corrects the issue and the earlier plan. `hand_card_value`, the mulligan's price (R4110000), prices a card by its cost. It reads keywords only through `face_uplift`, the difference between a card's two Unit faces, and J15 prints Evasive on both faces. So the mulligan does not change, and the plan has no hand test.

## Files to touch

| Path | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | `KeywordWeights`: new field `evasive`. `KeywordWeights::of`: new `Evasive` arm. `AI_EVAL.keyword`: `evasive` and its screen comment. `GREEDY_EVAL.keyword`: `evasive: 0.0` |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/evasive.rs` | new | Weight tests pinned to a `PRICED` const, and move-order tests that read `AI_EVAL` |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/mod.rs` | change | `pub mod evasive;` |

Do not touch any of these:
- `crates/engine/`, `crates/cards/`, `crates/server/`, `apps/`, `e2e/`.
- `spec/`: this is tuning, not a rules decision, so it needs no ruling. §9.9 already says that keywords count through the layers.
- `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`: its `of()` loops pick up the new entry by themselves.
- `crates/ai/src/features.rs`: `UNCOUNTED_KEYWORDS` is the retired learn lane's layout (R4159000).
- `crates/ai/src/shadow_ban.rs`, `AI_DECK_GATED_SETS`, `AI_BUDGET`, `AI_GATE_BUDGET`, `GREEDY_MULLIGAN`.
- Every existing test. The two `KeywordWeights` literals in `crates/ai/tests/ai/evaluate.rs` (lines 1446 and 1457) use `..AI_EVAL.keyword`, so they compile unchanged.

     - `(cd ../jackioh-wt/control && cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools) && cp ../jackioh-wt/control/target/release/jackioh ~/control-jackioh`

       #[serde(rename = "Evasive")]
       pub evasive: f64,
   ```
3. In `KeywordWeights::of`, add `KeywordKind::Evasive => Some(self.evasive),` after the `Windfury` arm and before `_ => None`.
4. In `AI_EVAL.keyword`, add this after `windfury: 0.0,`. Step 9 replaces the last sentence of the comment.

   - Delete `screen-4761.jsonl` and `/tmp/screen-4761.out`. Put the tally line in your notes for the pull request.
10. Run the checks under Done when.

4683.why: It fixes a real player-facing parity bug with file-and-line evidence, adding the existing label as hover text.

4686.why: It fixes a real bug players hit when an unmet rematch offer outlives the match window, confirmed with the code and tests cited.

4688.why: It resolves an accidental spec prefix collision in e2e that omits the board notices overlay from documentation and risks duplicate-prefix sharding errors.

4696.why: I checked it on main: when a socket drops while it is being seated, the server queues Disconnect ahead of Attach, and both hosts' on_attached then cancel the grace without checking the seat is still connected, so the seat sits empty with no countdown; the fix is small, the bug is confirmed, and it breaks behaviour that §9.5 and the server README promise.

4722.why: It mirrors two refusals POST already returns so the result screen stops offering a rematch that can only fail with 409.

4723.why: It mirrors two refusals the offer already returns so the co-op panel stops showing Play again when pressing it can only fail.

4730.why: Banned queue tickets still pair and strand an opponent today, and the fix extends decided R4019000 with cited code and tests.

4732.why: Confirmed: the #4273 guard in build-wasm.sh greps for a name that the #4283 strip removes, so it can no longer fire; a scratch crate on the pinned toolchain built with the script's settings still traps with the grep finding nothing, the proposed deny(linker_messages) turns that into a link error, and the real C module builds today with no linker messages, so the fix won't break it.

4733.why: Confirmed on main: the practice host clears a finished fight's save (host.rs:468), the dungeon's Menu next to Continue only navigates (FightScreen.tsx:181), and the kept run has nothing marking the fight as played, so a lost or conceded fight gets a free retry, which breaks §15's one lost fight ending the run.

4734.why: Confirmed on main: End turn reads 'Enemy turn' on every finished view (Board.tsx:632-633, 822), and a board mounted on a finished game hides its result for 3.8 s waiting on an effect that FxLayer plays only on a null-to-result change (FxLayer.tsx:464), so these are small fixes to bugs players can see.

4737.why: Confirmed rules bugs on a shipped card where board scopes, Cleave, and enemy permanents treat a card lying on a unit zone as a Unit rather than backrow, violating R4665000.

4743.why: Confirmed on main: boardKeyOf (actions.ts:107-109) keys only on turn, active seat and viewer, so when the opponent concedes or times out on your turn, a play's own picker (Prompt.tsx's outstandingNeed branch, z-index 40) stays open over the Victory panel (z-index 39) and a drag release still sends; adding the result to the key is a one-line fix that reuses the existing #2924 drop.

4761.why: It prices a live mechanic the evaluation scores at zero, with the missing arm confirmed and the value gated by a fork screen.

4770.why: It adds the spec-required R280 preview Edwin is missing, mirroring Quickstriker's proven hook with no rules change.

4779.why: Confirmed on main: #4353's six rows are keyed v0.6.8b and Elderberry's v0.6.8d, though v0.6.8d and v0.6.9 were the newest versions when they merged, so v0.6.8c/d and v0.6.8e/v0.6.9 replays fold under today's scripts and are refused; with four or more hand re-key PRs in eight days (#4061, #4090, #4521, #4630), this bug class is already here, and keying by fragment removes it.

4780.why: Confirmed on main: when a paid result arrives, the client drops the wallet, quests, tracks, packs, tokens and ladders but not the owned cosmetics, and nothing calls forgetOwnedCosmetics() after a game, so a Fleet level's reward shows locked until a reload; the fix is a few lines in one place.

4781.why: Confirmed on main: an open target prompt lights its options on the board as clickable, and pendingHighlight's own comment says that is so the prompt can be answered there, yet a click on a lit card or hero only answers Plague placement and on an own unit can show an unrelated attack notice; the fix keeps the list and copies placement's existing board answer.

decided.reason: the alarm exists to reach a player who looked away, and on a desktop switching tabs is the usual way of looking away. Today `accepting()` in `audio/engine.ts` drops every sound while the page is hidden, the alarm's beats included, and `Clock.tsx` leaves the mulligan silent on purpose, so a missed prompt is answered by the AI policy (R79) with no sound at all. Exempting only the viewer's own alarm keeps everything else quiet, as #4528 wanted. The Audio settings hint ("Sound effects and voices sta
decided.title: Patch: the clock alarm covers the mulligan and background tabs

decided.reason: confirmed. `HandHints.tsx` gives each pip only an `aria-label`, while `FieldBadges.tsx` gives the same icon family a `title`. A new player meeting the altar-and-number pip has nothing that names it, and the fix is one attribute from labels that are already translated.
decided.title: Patch: hand-hint pips name themselves on hover like field marks do
Patch: drop stale unmet rematch offers when match window expires to avoid phantom offers

decided.reason: this is a regression #4608 caused, and it's measured: the AI wins a draw-then-lethal scene on 13 of 40 seeds as shipped, and on 40 of 40 with `replay_fill_steps` at 3, while every `r4608000_` test still passes. The fill already exists and is tested (R4447000), so this turns it on rather than adding new search code. Hold its fork screen to `training/improve.md`'s own rule, not the issue's looser one: keep 3 only when `forkEdgeLow` is above 0, or, if the screen is inconclusive, by the scene tests

decided.reason: nothing breaks today. `SMOKE` names neither 56 spec, the shared weight only nudges the nightly shards, and the miscount is in a README. A rename is polish only the maintainer sees, and it risks breaking whatever refers to the spec by its file name, for no change players or CI would notice. Fine to fold into the next change that touches these specs.

decided.reason: confirmed. `DuelHost::on_attached` (`crates/shared/src/host/duel.rs:727`) calls `clear_grace` without reading `connected[home]`. So the `Disconnect` that `on_socket_gone` queues starts the grace, and the `Attach` queued behind it cancels it, leaving the seat empty with no countdown. The co-op host does the same, and the AI never takes the seat. It's the mid-attach branch #4529 added for #4509 this week, shipped doing the opposite of what its comment and `crates/server/README.md` promise, with no
decided.title: Patch: a match socket that drops while it is being seated starts its seat's disconnect grace, in 1v1 and co-op, instead of its own arrival cancelling it

decided.reason: it is reachable (a Nerf may add Crater to a card in hand, `TUNE_NERF_HAND_KEYWORDS`, a GIGA one included), but what Crater should lock on a GIGA Unit is unruled. R783010 locks "its own unit zone", and a GIGA's span includes the other row's zones, so "all four" would also lock backrow zones. That is a design call on a rare interaction. Rule it first, and the fix is small.
decided.title: Patch: a GIGA Unit with Crater locks all four of its spanned zones on arrival

decided.reason: real rules bugs on shipped cards, confirmed in `crates/engine/src/effects/plague.rs`. The placement prompt itself is fine: it is a `PromptKind::Target` prompt, and `open_prompt` already filters its options through `targeting_point::targetable_options`, which asks `evasive_bars`. The random branch (a random cast, or while Mayor acts) skips that filter and draws with a plain `sink.rng.int`. So it can place a Spell's counter on an Evasive card (R452 and R1200: a random target draws from the legal o
decided.title: Patch: Plague Counter placement prompts refuse Evasive cards and Mayor draws them with Lucky

decided.reason: one bug of this class has shipped (#4623's forced Windfast stand-in), and it is fixed now, with tests that fail without the fix. That is one case, not a recurring class. The proposal also has the monitor call `restrictions::attack_restriction` itself, which restates the engine's check rather than judging from events, against the monitor's own "an oracle, not the fix restated" rule, so a bug inside that function would pass it. Worth revisiting if a second attack-restriction bug gets through.

decided.reason: this undoes two decisions made on purpose. R2990003 rejected "closing a watch whenever its watcher and anyone in the match stand blocked, which would let a rival end a friend's watch by blocking the watcher", and R3731002 has a 2v2 watch refused by a block with the watched person's teammate only. Presence hiding Watch for a block with any of the four is the stricter half, also chosen. Opponents' blocks already keep their emotes apart (R2990003). Changing this is a design call for the maintainers

decided.reason: the blur is cosmetic (R3548001), hides one field of a card in its owner's view alone, and the card's other fields usually still name it, so a player who knows the cards reads through it as the AI does. No player can see the AI read past its own blur, and the issue says self-play can't measure any gain. That leaves a hard change to `redact` and `determinize`, with new sampling in every decision, for nothing anyone would notice.
decided.title: Patch: the AI reads its Tipsy-blurred cards as blurred

decided.reason: confirmed. Edwin Van'Spacechief's script declares `condition_met` and `cry` but no `preview`, though its Cry computes its gain from the cards played earlier this turn, and §10.8 has every card whose text computes a number from the board carry it as `preview` (R280). Quickstriker counts the same thing and already previews it, so this is a small fix that copies an existing hook, and players stop counting their earlier plays by hand.
decided.title: Patch: Edwin Van'Spacechief previews its Combo gain

decided.reason: the bug class is already here. Kept scripts have been re-keyed by hand six times in eight days, and two keys are stale on `main` today. #4356 (#4353's Balance Changes V) merged with v0.6.8c and v0.6.8d already in `patches.json`, yet its rows in `crates/cards/src/history.rs` stop at `v0.6.8b`, so a v0.6.8c or v0.6.8d replay where one of those six cards acted folds under today's script and is refused as `rules_changed`. No check can see this, since the merge queue ships versions under a PR that is
decided.title: Patch: kept card scripts take their last version from the patch that ships them, so a patch shipped first never leaves one stale

decided.reason: confirmed. `forgetPaidReads` in `apps/web/src/net/api.ts` drops the wallet, quests, tracks, packs, tokens and both ladders after a paid game, but not the owned cosmetics, and nothing calls `forgetOwnedCosmetics()` after a game. So a Fleet track level's reward shows as locked and can't be equipped until a reload, right as the player earns it. It's a few lines in one place, at the cost of one more read per paid game.
decided.title: Patch: a cosmetic a Fleet track level pays shows owned in the Collection as soon as the game ends, not after a reload
